text: A name for the element, so that a rule in a nested loop can say @item.sku instead of @2.sku.
The order of the list, like SQL's order by: one key per line, a direction and where the elements with no value go. The next key breaks the ties of the one before.
What the output has when no element is left: the list is left out, or an empty list is written.
Apply keeps the choices; the gear then shows them in a few words.
